products.name: Splice
products.note: Mobile video editing; music licensing; content creation; GoPro ownership

profile_text.body:
Splice, headquartered in New York, NY, describes itself as the industry's highest quality royalty-free sample library, offering access to millions of sounds made by top artists, labels, and sound designers. The platform provides samples, sound effects, and presets, and includes a Sounds Plugin that integrates directly into a digital audio workstation, allowing users to search, preview, and drag and drop sounds within a project. Splice also offers a mobile application that lets users discover and record song ideas on the go and export stems to a DAW or share with collaborators.

The site highlights a partnership with Xfer Records, featuring Xfer's wavetable synthesizer with new features and workflow enhancements available through the platform. Additional offerings include free, pro-grade presets and a monthly Free Drops program. The held facts classify Splice under video generation and editing, with notes referencing mobile video editing, music licensing, content creation, and GoPro ownership, and record a New York law exposure count of 220, though no litigation cases or MCP server presence are on file.
